answer: Epoch-locked reputation vesting slows Sybil farms. An agent's earned weight sits on a ledge for several epochs before it vests, and quitting early forfeits the unvested plume of rewards. Fresh identities start with zero vested stake, so a farm of fakes must keep each one alive and funded through the full vest window. That ties up ferrous-hard capital per clone with no early exit, making honest long-lived agents cheaper than a disposable swarm.
